elements.before: Independent, lender-grade analysis for pet boarding kennels, doggy daycare, grooming, and integrated pet-care facilities across SBA 7(a) and 504, USDA Business and Industry, conventional bank, specialty, and bridge capital. This page is our standing read on how the dual recurring-daycare-versus-episodic-boarding revenue model works, how ramp-up and occupancy forecasts fail review, and the difference between the market study, the feasibility study, and the going-concern appraisal a lender requires.
elements.after: Daycare brings recurring weekday revenue and boarding brings episodic holiday peaks, so each pet boarding and daycare feasibility study models both through the ramp to stabilized occupancy. Feasibility Study Company writes them for kennel owners, developers and their lenders, each starting from a market study of the households nearby. The scope covers kennels, doggy daycare, grooming and integrated pet resorts, a field IBISWorld counted at 169,481 businesses, up from 162,802 in 2024.1 Tell us about the facility, and the study will be framed for a 7(a) or 504 loan, a USDA Business and Industry loan, or specialty, bank or bridge credit.
